items.reason: A gentle, active-free cleanser keeps the base simple while your skin adjusts to new actives.
Niacinamide is a gentle first active that suits an oily-labelled skin and pairs well with a retinol.
A lower-strength retinol is a sensible starting point for a night-time active for someone new to them.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports your moisture score and helps skin stay comfortable with a retinol.
A daily mineral SPF 50 is essential alongside a retinol and protects the look of your skin.

response.routine_note: Mornings: cleanse, niacinamide, moisturizer, then sunscreen. Evenings: cleanse, then retinol only 2 nights a week at first (before moisturizer), building up slowly if skin stays comfortable.
